_readme: Every numeric claim the marketing site makes about court data lives here.
Three different numbers shipped simultaneously before this file existed:
the homepage schema said 'over 22,000 courts', the live demo said '26,000+
courts with reviews', and the courts directory said '3,443'. All three were
hand-written in different files and none of them agreed.
tools/verify-claims.mjs is a CI gate. It fails the build if any HTML file
contains a court-count number that is not one of the values below, so a
TERMS. A court LOCATION is one row in public.courts: a park, club, school
or rec centre. A COURT is one playing surface. One location holds several.
Never use the two words interchangeably - that ambiguity is what made
'574 courts' and 'DEDICATED COURTS 1909' both true on the same page.

app.query: SELECT count(*), sum(court_count) FROM public.courts WHERE removed_at IS NULL AND review_status = 'approved'
note: This is exactly what a user sees, because the courts SELECT policy is
(removed_at IS NULL AND (review_status = 'approved' OR created_by = auth.uid()
OR is_admin_or_mod())) - the same predicate for anon and authenticated.
The older 22,311 figure in the iOS repo counted rows that included 14,903
PlayPickleball-scraped venues. Those are soft-deleted (removed_at set) and
are no longer visible to anyone. 22,311 is dead. Do not revive it.
tools/courtgen/build_site.py publishes a city only when it has
MIN_COURTS (5) or more locations, and skips county/township labels.
That is a deliberate thin-content guard, not a data limit: 7,231 more
locations across roughly 4,420 smaller cities exist in the app and are
not on the web. Lowering MIN_COURTS is an open decision, tracked in
These three values are GENERATED. build_site.py writes them into
courts/index.html and courts/us.html. Never hand-edit them; run the
generator and update this file to match.

bannedNumbers.22000: app court count before the PlayPickleball rows were removed
bannedNumbers.26000: never had a basis in any query
bannedNumbers.20000: rounded form of the same dead figure

bannedPhrases.courts with reviews: public.court_reviews is empty; there are no court reviews
